text: Amaterasu chose her grandson Ninigi to rule the earth and gave him three treasures: the mirror, the jewels and the serpent's sword.
spoken: Ah-mah-teh-rah-soo chose her grandson Nee-nee-gee to rule the earth and gave him three treasures: the mirror, the jewels and the serpent's sword.

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
